scope: Relative reference complexity within this skill and its stated objectives; not an absolute human-difficulty score.

levels.label: Foundation
levels.criteria: Expose a core relation with limited prerequisite planning and accessible recovery.

levels.label: Combination
levels.criteria: Connect preparations, changing input access, or reuse of the same mechanism.

levels.label: Planning
levels.criteria: Coordinate deeper dependencies, constrained shared space, role changes, or recovery tradeoffs.

difficulty.rationale: Combination: independent shield handoffs lead to reuse of the final block after a safe-ground change of pushing side; its pre-positioned handoff shields require less preparation than the BxC realization. Structural estimate, not empirical difficulty.

Planning: co-transport brings two tools into a shared workspace, then separate placement, a clear-ground return and a second-tool approach create the final handoff; deeper preparation than BxB, with block-count and endpoint confounds.
